events.text: A beggar offers you a martial manual wrapped in oilcloth. 'Ancient,' he says. 'Very ancient. Ten taels.'

effects.log: It is a real manual, very ordinary, and actually useful. (−10 taels)

choices.text: Ask to read the first page

effects.log: He lets you. You memorise it and walk away. He shouts after you.

events.text: Two sect disciples are dueling on the road, and neither will let you pass.

ok.log: Both land in the ditch. Both apologise to you.

fail.log: They both turn on you. You all end up in the ditch.

effects.log: A good duel. You learn from both.

events.text: The cook at the roadside inn catches a thrown knife between two fingers without looking up from his pot.

effects.log: 'I am a cook,' he says. He teaches you knife-work while you chop onions.
He winks. Your meal is free.

events.text: A formal duel invitation arrives on red paper. The challenger is someone you have never heard of.

ok.log: A good duel. You win, and gain a friend.

fail.log: You lose to an unknown. Humbling.

effects.log: The challenger is disappointed and finds someone else.

events.text: The new list of promising young masters is published. Your name is not on it.

effects.log: Next year.
Lists are for people who need them.

events.text: A great sect leader has died. The whole murim comes to the funeral, even enemies.

effects.log: You see every famous master in one courtyard.
Who will succeed him is already being fought over.

events.text: Two poison masters duel by drinking each other's poisons. It takes a week.

effects.log: A draw. Both drink an antidote and go home. You learn a lot about antidotes.
A draw. Your favourite bows to the other one.

events.text: A legendary blade is found in a river. Half the murim comes to claim it.

ok.log: You win it. You also win a lot of enemies.

fail.log: You are eliminated in the second round.

effects.log: In the end it is stolen by a child. Nobody can find the child.

events.text: An old training ground in the forest: stakes worn smooth by a thousand years of feet.

effects.log: Your balance improves. You fall off twice.
Names of students from centuries ago.

events.text: The Beggars' Union posts its monthly news on the teahouse wall: who won, who died, who disappeared.

effects.log: You know who to avoid this month.
Not there. Or there, in small print, under "rumours".

events.text: A blind swordsman in the market challenges anyone to touch him with a stick.

ok.log: You touch his sleeve. He laughs and buys you tea.

fail.log: He taps you on the head forty times.

effects.log: He hears everything. You learn to listen.

events.text: A group of young disciples is lost in the mountains after a training exercise.

ok.log: You find them cold and scared, and lead them home.

fail.log: You find them the next day, very cold.

effects.log: The sect sends everyone. They are found by dawn.

events.text: Two old masters who hated each other for forty years are drinking tea together in the market, laughing.

effects.log: 'We got old,' says one. 'And he makes good tea,' says the other.
They tell you stories of each other's worst defeats.

events.text: Someone in a teahouse gives you a nickname. It is not a flattering one.

effects.log: You work hard for a year. The new nickname sticks.
Owning it takes its power away.

events.text: In an old temple, a loose brick reveals a narrow passage down into the dark.

ok.log: A small shrine with an old manual. You leave an offering.

fail.log: A dead end and a lot of bats.

effects.log: Some secrets are someone else's.

events.text: A mysterious old man asks you three riddles. 'If you answer, I will teach you something.'

ok.log: Three correct. He teaches you a breathing trick you use for the rest of your life.

fail.log: One out of three. He laughs and gives you a peach.

effects.log: He cannot answer. He is delighted.

events.text: A man wanted for murder begs for your help. He swears he killed a slaver.

ok.log: True. You help him escape to the south.

fail.log: You cannot tell. You let him go anyway.

effects.log: The magistrate thanks you. The man looks at you once.

events.text: A famous master emerges from twenty years of seclusion. The murim holds its breath.

effects.log: He walks through the market, buys noodles and goes home. The murim exhales.
Masters come and go.

events.text: Two calligraphers duel with brushes, and their strokes cut the paper like blades.

effects.log: You see the sword in the brush.
The winner gives it to you. It is beautiful and a little frightening.

events.text: A hunter tells you about a hidden valley where the grass never dies.

ok.log: A valley of warm springs and rare herbs. You rest there a week.

fail.log: You find a valley of mud.

choices.text: Buy him a drink for the story

effects.log: He tells three more stories. None of them are true. All of them are good.
